worker.name: Worker
worker.description: Can mine gold from adjacent resource tiles. Continuous Auto-Harvest.

mech.name: Mech
mech.description: Combat-heavy mechs. Move mechs to attack hostiles automatically.

artillery.name: Artillery
artillery.description: Long-range shelling platforms with a 1-2 hex range.

powerTower.name: PowerTower
powerTower.description: Stationary worker-built tower. Only one PowerTower can occupy a tile, but mobile units may still pass through.
